Fictional Document Annotation Services Agreement
This agreement governs the provision of document annotation services by AnnotaWorks
Ltd. to the Client for a term of 12 months, with a total projected service output of 119.39
thousand annotated units and a corresponding cost of 77.60 thousand, yielding an
operating surplus of 41.79 thousand as simulated in the pricing model. The parties agree to
the scope, obligations, and quality standards set forth in the following sections.

1 Scope of Services
Table 2: Projected annual output and cost for annotation services
The scope defines the annotation tasks, volume, and delivery schedule. The Provider shall
annotate documents according to the guidelines and quality thresholds specified herein,
ensuring timely delivery and adherence to the agreed standards across every batch
produced during the term.
SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT | RESEARCH PROTOTYPE
1.1 Annotation Tasks and Deliverables
This section details the specific annotation tasks, including entity recognition, relation
extraction, and classification, and the format of deliverables. Each task is subject to
acceptance criteria and review procedures before any batch is deemed complete and
eligible for invoicing.
1.1.1 Task Descriptions and Guidelines
The Provider shall perform annotation tasks as described in the guidelines, which cover
labeling conventions, edge cases, and quality checks. The guidelines are incorporated by
reference and may be updated by mutual written agreement of the parties when task
definitions evolve.
1.1.1.1 Quality Assurance and Review
The Provider shall implement a quality assurance process, including sample reviews and
feedback loops, to maintain annotation accuracy and consistency. The Client may conduct
periodic audits to verify compliance with the agreed thresholds and documented
conventions.
1.1.1.1.1 Sampling and Accuracy Checks
The Provider shall perform sampling on 240 units per batch and report accuracy metrics.
The Client may request additional checks if accuracy falls below the agreed threshold, and
the Provider shall bear the cost of any expanded sampling required.
1.1.1.1.2 Error Correction and Rework
Errors identified during reviews shall be corrected within 5 business days. Rework shall be
at the Provider's expense if errors exceed the agreed error rate, and repeated failures may
trigger the service credit remedies described later in this agreement.
1.1.1.2 Delivery Schedule and Format
Deliverables shall be submitted according to the schedule set out in the milestone table, in
the specified electronic format. Late deliveries may incur penalties as set forth in the
service levels, and the Client may reject batches that fail format checks.
1.1.2 Client Responsibilities
The Client shall provide timely access to source documents, guidelines, and feedback, and
shall designate a point of contact for approvals and clarifications. Delays caused by the
Client shall extend affected deadlines by a corresponding period.

Table 3: Acceptance criteria checklist for deliverables
1.2 Acceptance Criteria
Acceptance of deliverables is conditional on meeting the quality metrics and format
requirements. The Client shall notify the Provider of acceptance or rejection within 2
business days, and silence beyond that period shall be treated as acceptance.
Supporting records are presented in Table 3.
2 Service Levels and Performance
The Provider shall meet the service levels specified herein, including response times and
accuracy targets, to ensure reliable and consistent service delivery throughout the term
and across all workstreams assigned to it.
2.1 Performance Metrics and Reporting
The Provider shall report monthly on key performance indicators, including output volume
and accuracy. The metrics are used to assess service levels and identify areas for
improvement, and the reporting format is set out in the metrics template.
Supporting records are presented in Table 5.
2.1.1 Service Credits and Remedies
If the Provider fails to meet service levels, service credits may apply as a remedy. The
credits are calculated based on the extent of the shortfall and are subject to the limitations
described in the credit provisions of this agreement.
2.1.1.1 Credit Calculation and Application
Service credits are calculated as a percentage of the monthly fee, as detailed in the credit
schedule table. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are the sole remedy for
performance shortfalls, except where termination rights apply.
Supporting records are presented in Table 4.

2.1.1.1.1 Credit Request Procedure
The Client must request service credits within 2 business days of the shortfall, providing
evidence. The Provider shall verify and apply credits promptly, and disputed claims shall be
escalated to the review meeting.
Figure 1: Limitations on service credits by shortfall type
2.1.1.1.2 Limitations on Credits
Service credits shall not exceed the total fees paid for the affected month and are not
available for force majeure events or Client-caused delays. The limitation table lists the
caps that apply to each shortfall type.
Supporting records are presented in Figure 1.
2.1.1.2 Performance Review Meetings
The parties shall hold quarterly performance review meetings to discuss metrics, resolve
issues, and plan improvements. Minutes shall be recorded and signed by both parties, and
agreed actions shall be tracked until closure.
2.1.2 Reporting Obligations
The Provider shall submit monthly reports on annotation output, accuracy, and compliance
with service levels. Reports shall be in a format agreed by the parties and shall accompany
each invoice submitted for the relevant period.
SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT | RESEARCH PROTOTYPE
2.2 Continuous Improvement
The Provider shall propose and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance
quality and efficiency, subject to the Client's approval. Progress on approved initiatives shall
be summarized in the quarterly review meetings.
